strings.zh: 最近好多带精灵来看病的人啊,{NEWLINE}都快忙不过来了。
strings.en: So many people have been{NEWLINE}bringing in Pokémon for treatment{CLEAR}lately. We can barely keep up.

strings.zh: 蘑蘑菇的技能蘑菇孢子,{NEWLINE}要等到45级才能学会,{CLEAR}但蘑蘑菇23级就可以进化了。{SCROLL}我为了让蘑蘑菇学会蘑菇孢子,{NEWLINE}刻意取消了它的进化。
strings.en: Shroomish learns Spore only at level{NEWLINE}45, but it can evolve at level 23.{SCROLL}So I deliberately stopped its evolution{NEWLINE}to make sure Shroomish learns Spore.

strings.zh: 我本来跟小梦妖在愤怒湖周边玩,{NEWLINE}突然小梦妖就变得非常痛苦,{CLEAR}于是我赶紧带它来精灵中心看病。{CLEAR}可是回到卡吉镇之后,{CLEAR}小梦妖的不适症状明显减轻了。{CLEAR}或许不是小梦妖的身体出了问题,{CLEAR}而是愤怒湖有问题？
strings.en: I was playing with my Misdreavus{NEWLINE}near the Lake of Rage when it{CLEAR}suddenly started suffering, so I{CLEAR}hurried it to the Pokémon Center.{SCROLL}But once we got back to Mahogany{NEWLINE}Town, its symptoms eased a lot.{SCROLL}Maybe it’s not Misdreavus{NEWLINE}that’s sick. Maybe something’s{CLEAR}wrong with the Lake of Rage?

strings.zh: 多亏我平时对独角蛛锻炼有方,{NEWLINE}在别人的精灵出问题的时候,{CLEAR}我的独角蛛依然很健康。
strings.en: Thanks to how well I train my Ariados,{NEWLINE}it’s still healthy while other people’s{CLEAR}Pokémon are having problems.
strings.notes: ext-review ROOT-015: 独角蛛 = Ariados (glossary, as in 0113); the cry is Ariados too

strings.zh: 听说卡吉镇特产商店{NEWLINE}好像换人经营了,{CLEAR}卖的商品也跟原来不一样了。
strings.en: I hear the Mahogany Town{NEWLINE}souvenir shop has new owners, and{CLEAR}what they sell has changed too.

strings.zh: 特产商店又重新开始{NEWLINE}售卖美味小吃了,{CLEAR}这一趟总算没有白来。
strings.en: The souvenir shop is selling{NEWLINE}delicious snacks again. This{CLEAR}trip wasn’t wasted after all.

strings.zh: 你去过东边的冰之通路了吗？{NEWLINE}那里的自然条件非常恶劣,{CLEAR}但是厉害的训练家们{CLEAR}都会去那里修行。
strings.en: Have you been to the Ice Path to the{NEWLINE}east? Conditions there are brutal, but{CLEAR}strong Trainers all go there to train.

strings.zh: 唉,本来是想跟朋友们{NEWLINE}去愤怒湖露营的,{CLEAR}可是我的小果然突发不适,{CLEAR}只能先回精灵中心治疗了。
strings.en: Sigh. I was going to go camping at{NEWLINE}the Lake of Rage with my friends, but{CLEAR}my Wynaut suddenly got sick. I had to{CLEAR}bring it to the Pokémon Center first.

strings.zh: 有一位在冰之通路修行的训练家{NEWLINE}打来电话说他的精灵生病了,{CLEAR}现在需要一些多利果{CLEAR}为他的精灵治病。{CLEAR}但是我这里太忙了走不开,{CLEAR}能请你帮我送过去吗？
strings.en: A Trainer training in the Ice Path{NEWLINE}called to say his Pokémon is sick. He{CLEAR}needs some Durin Berries to treat it.{SCROLL}But I’m too busy here to get away.{NEWLINE}Could you take them to him for me?

strings.zh: 好吧,那我问问别人有没有时间。
strings.en: All right. I’ll ask around and{NEWLINE}see if anyone else has time.

strings.zh: 谢谢你愿意帮忙,{NEWLINE}这是多利果,请收好。
strings.en: Thank you for helping.{NEWLINE}Here are the Durin Berries.

strings.zh: 求助人说需要10个多利果,{NEWLINE}我为您准备了15个。{CLEAR}剩余的多利果{CLEAR}就当作是您帮忙的感谢了。
strings.en: He said he needs 10 Durin Berries, so{NEWLINE}I’ve prepared 15 for you. Please keep{CLEAR}the rest as thanks for your help.

strings.zh: 每天来精灵中心治疗的人很多,{NEWLINE}所以我们的工作还是很繁重的。
strings.en: Lots of people come to the{NEWLINE}Pokémon Center for treatment every{CLEAR}day, so our work is still{CLEAR}really demanding.
